correctness.rationale: Verified the exact change of coordinates F=t^2(u+v+w)+uvw in characteristic 2 and that projection is a nonsquare quadratic purely inseparable extension. On F=0, multiplication by u+v+w sends the Gauss partials to (vw(v+w),uw(u+w),uv(u+v)); all projective common zeros are the seven F2 points, local linear terms span cotangents, and seven independent cubic conditions leave precisely the three stated cubics. Blowup net -K=3H-Sum E is base-point-free, square two, hence dominant generic degree two. Its ratio Jacobian wedge vanishes identically modulo two, giving purely inseparable degree two; composition degree four. Integral Steiner quartic reduces to the fourth power of the plane equation; this is not the reduced special-fiber dual. Independently rederived polynomial identities, seven F2-point base locus, net rank, and derivative identity with SymPy. The all-algebraic-closure base locus uses the proof, not just finite F2 testing.
